claims.explanation: NVP-AUY922 is a potent HSP90 inhibitor whose selectivity likely reflects dependence on HSP90 client proteins that drive proliferation and survival, particularly mutated BRAF, mutant KRAS, and activated PI3K/AKT signaling, which are known HSP90 clients or depend on HSP90 for stability. Lines with these oncogenic drivers (e.g., BRAF-mutant thyroid/melanoma, KRAS-mutant pancreatic/lung, PIK3CA-mutant lines) are enriched among sensitive lines, whereas many resistant lines lack these dependencies or have alternative survival pathways. TP53 mutation is common across both groups and is not selective.

features.basis: Mutant BRAF is an HSP90 client; BRAF-mutant lines (BCPAP, 8305C, WM793) are among the most sensitive.
Mutant KRAS depends on HSP90 for stability and signaling; KRAS-mutant lines (PK45H, SW1990, NCIH1792, SW1573, OV7) are enriched among sensitive lines.
PI3K/AKT pathway activation is regulated by HSP90 and PI3K-mutant lines (SNU840, KYSE70, HCC1954, HGC27, SW1573) are sensitive.
Higher expression of the drug target HSP90AA1 may increase dependence on its chaperone function.
Higher expression of the drug target HSP90AB1 may increase dependence on its chaperone function.
ERBB3 is an HSP90 client and ERBB3-mutant NCIH1792 is sensitive; ERBB3 was also upregulated in the virtual cell response.
MET is an HSP90 client and MET-mutant lines (HGC27, 8305C) are among the sensitive lines.
NF1 loss activates RAS/MAPK signaling, which is HSP90-dependent; NF1-mutant lines (S117, COLO792) are sensitive.
PTEN loss activates PI3K/AKT but may also induce compensatory survival pathways; PTEN-mutant lines are enriched among resistant lines (DMS273, FTC133, OV90, TE4).
RB1 loss may reduce dependence on HSP90 clients; RB1-mutant lines (DMS273, FTC133) are among the least affected.
CDKN2A loss is common in resistant lines (YD10B, SNU1214, OV90), possibly reflecting alternative proliferation mechanisms.
TP53 mutation is widespread across both sensitive and resistant lines, so it is not a selective feature; listed only to note lack of predictive value.
